title: AI-Powered GaP Repository: Democratizing Access to Political Knowledge for Young Women in South Asia
summary: The Centre for Gender and Politics proposes multilingual NLP, contextual recommendations, and mentorship matching for young women in South Asia.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The proposed AI version of the GaP repository would add multilingual information access, contextual recommendations, and mentorship matching to improve political-information access and guidance. The launched version uses a conventional content-management system without these AI functions.
purpose: Use multilingual AI assistance and personalized matching to improve political-information access.

ratings.reason: Improved access and guidance through the proposed AI functions remain intended. These functions are not part of the existing CMS.
Greater political participation through AI-assisted access remains an intended downstream effect.

ai_role.statement: Proposed NLP, contextual recommendation, and mentorship-matching functions would personalize access and guidance.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: AI-Powered GaP Repository: Democratizing Access to Political Knowledge for Young Women in South Asia

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: GaP plans an AI interface for political knowledge
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
